messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

A 200 mg capsule contains 224 mg.

Triplet: ["150 mg capsule", "contains", "168 mg sertraline hydrochloride"]

The relation 'contains' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity includes or comprises the specified quantity of the substance mentioned in the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
B. 'involves': The subject condition or process includes or is characterized by the entity specified by the object entity.
C. 'can build up in': The subject substance may accumulate in the body or within the specified entity.
D. 'may be accompanied by': The subject condition or entity may occur alongside or be associated with the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has packaging': The subject drug is packaged with the components described by the object entity.
